# MotionView Docs - for LLMs

> MotionView is a platform-agnostic desktop application (Windows, Linux, macOS) designed to visually plan, simulate, and analyze autonomous robotics routes. It features an interactive real-time Viewing dashboard and a low-code Planning timeline sequencer. Its companion C++ PROS library, MVLib, utilizes a compact binary serial protocol for low-overhead telemetry streaming.

Main GitHub Page: https://github.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView
Live Documentation: https://lewispinstein-hue.github.io/MotionView
Creator: [Lewis Pinstein](https://github.com/lewispinstein-hue)

## Core Resources
- [Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/Home.md): Main documentation landing page and overview.
- [Download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/Download.md): Installation binaries and build targets for all desktop platforms.

## MotionView (Desktop Client)
- [Viewing Mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/ViewingMode.md): How to livestream robot telemetry and manage visual real-time dashboard layouts.
- [Planning Mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/PlanningMode.md): Visual autonomous route drafting, waypoint placement, and the interactive object-method sequencer timeline.
- [Planning Mode Template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/PlanningExportTemplate.md): Custom templates and variables used to export visual timelines into deployable production robot code.
- [Keybinds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/Keybinds.md): Keyboard shortcuts for efficient map navigation and node manipulation.

### Setup & Installation
- [Installing on macOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/InstallingMacOS.md): Guardrails, security permissions, and installation steps for macOS.
- [Installing on Windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/InstallingWindows.md): Installer usage and requirements for running MotionView natively on Windows.
- [Setup Live Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/SetupLivestreaming.md): Configuring serial and wired port paths to stream telemetry to the frontend.

### Specifications & Changelogs
- [JSON Schema v3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/MotionViewSchemaV3.md): The structural schema definition supporting combined viewing paths and planning sequences.
- [JSON Schema v2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/MotionViewSchemaV2.md): Legacy export schema definition for backwards compatibility.
- [Logging API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/MotionViewAPI.md): Reference protocol detailing the underlying binary and raw terminal data transmission schemas.
- [Changelog v1.3.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/Changelog/v1.3.0.md): Log of graph zooming enhancements, timeline sequencing features, and platform-wide bug fixes.
- [Changelog v1.2.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MotionView/Changelog/v1.2.0.md): Historic log of initial widget upgrades and interface implementations.

## MVLib (Companion C++ PROS Library)
- [Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Setup.md): Integrating the mvlib template pack directly into your PROS firmware environment.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Configuration.md): Setting up ports, baud rates, and library definitions inside initialization files.
- [Logs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Logs.md): Utilizing global logging utilities for status reports and custom string telemetry.
- [Watches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Watches.md): Registering functions via the Watch API, utilizing debounced onChange filters, and handling compile-time naming constraints.
- [Waypoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Waypoints.md): Tracking robot positioning markers, tracking timeouts, and assigning compile-time name length safety.
- [SD Logging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/SDLogging.md): Configuring micro-SD card logging fallbacks, folder generation rules, and file-retention policies.
- [Updating to v3.0.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/UpdatingTo-v3.0.0.md): Complete API migration guide detailing renamed functions, unified enums, and breaking structural refactors.

### Changelogs
- [Changelog v3.0.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Changelog/v3.0.0.md): Complete breaking change record including unified WatchMode parameters, compile-time label limits, and theta scale ring optimizations.
- [Changelog v2.0.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lewispinstein-hue/MotionView/refs/heads/gh-pages/docs/MVLib/Changelog/v2.0.0.md): Historical reference for legacy v2 functional implementations.
